dedupe_keys.name: wdseventdb water distribution event diagnosis benchmark

description: WDSEventDB contains measured operating and disturbance scenarios from a sensor-instrumented water-distribution testbed at Lehigh University’s CONCISE Laboratory. The authors publish clean operation, cyberattack, leakage and sensor-failure folders to support event diagnosis and anomaly detection. Unlike synthetic network benchmarks, these records come from a physical laboratory system. The spatial scope is that testbed in the United States; the inspected landing pages do not state sensor counts, sampling intervals or the measurement dates. The resource is distributed as a ZIP archive through Zenodo and mirrored in GitHub. Zenodo records the dataset under CC BY 4.0 with open, free access. GitHub reports CC0, so the two copies have inconsistent licence metadata; the Zenodo licence is retained for this canonical data record. The README also displays an unrelated DOI in its badge image, while the badge link resolves to the correct Zenodo item. Simulation uses include validating event-detection logic and comparing simulated failures with laboratory measurements. The data complement data-leakdb and model-wntr, but no tested interchange format or field-scale representativeness is claimed.
name: WDSEventDB: water distribution event diagnosis benchmark
notes: G8; G8-0007. GitHub CC0 and Zenodo CC BY 4.0 conflict. Canonical data licence follows Zenodo. The README badge image contains 10.5281/zenodo.1313116, but its actual link and Zenodo identity point to 17547955. Data were not downloaded. Sensor details remain unknown.
